data.name: Baaqir
data.gender_notes: Baaqir is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘baqara’ which means ‘to possess, to have wealth, or to be rich’. In Islamic history, Imam Ali al-Baqir is the fifth Imam of Shia Islam, and was known for his vast knowledge and wisdom. The name carries a spiritual significance of being rich in knowledge, wisdom, and faith. The name Baaqir carries the meaning “Richer, possessed of abundance” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Baaqir usually hope their child will grow to embody richer, possessed of abundance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Blessed with spiritual wealth and wisdom
data.etymology: Baaqir belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Richer, possessed of abundance.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Baaqir total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
